interpretation: This is a descriptive reference, not a yield or production forecast.
Cocoa is a perennial tree crop. Establishment/transplanting replaces an annual sowing date.
ICCO cocoa-year production, USDA area estimates and FAOSTAT calendar-year statistics use different vintages and definitions and must not be silently merged.

headline_reference.season_definition: completed cocoa marketing year, October 2024 to September 2025
headline_reference.production_status: ICCO latest 2024/25 estimate/projection; not a district total
headline_reference.source_difference_note: USDA's March 2025 outlook was 700,000 t; the later ICCO 2024/25 annual reference is 600,000 t. The ICCO value is used as the headline and both are retained to expose revision uncertainty.

faostat_calendar_year_reference.note: FAOSTAT calendar-year series with source flags preserved; not directly interchangeable with the 2024/25 cocoa-year references.

crop_cycle.establishment_note: COCOBOD distributes hybrid seedlings mostly from May to July so farmers can establish or rehabilitate farms during the rains.
crop_cycle.calendar_note: These are the conventional biological/marketing windows. COCOBOD moved the official opening of the 2025/26 season to August, so commercial opening dates can change.

latest_open_regional_breakdown.measure: COCOBOD graded and sealed purchases, not farm production
latest_open_regional_breakdown.warning: Do not present these old regional purchase shares as a current regional production map.
